entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:24871
Court No. - 91

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 13529 of 2020
Applicant :- Mohd. Ayyaz @ Ashu Siddiqui

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Akbar Shah Alam Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A,Onkar Singh,Sachin Malik
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and
perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 24.12.2019 as well as entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 280/9 of 2020 pending in the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.), Kairana, Shamli arising out of filing of Charge-sheet dated 24.12.2019 in Case Crime No. 0368 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 354, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act, P.S. Kandhla,
District Shamli.

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (J.D.), Kairana, Shamli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further prayed to stay the further proceeding of the aforesaid case during the pendency of the present case.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that opposite party No. 2 who is the wife of applicant No. 1 has lodged an F.I.R. against entire family members by the applicant.

It is further submitted that incident is said to have been taken place on 1.5.2019 whereas F.I.R. has been lodged Mohd. Ayyaz @ Ashu Siddiqui vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135713350/
1 on 27.9.2019 but there is no explanation of such inordinate delay.

entities.text: Mohd. Ayyaz @ Ashu Siddiqui vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During medical examination of the opposite party No. 2 no injury was found however she refused to undergo internal and external medical examination.
It is submitted that no allegations are made against any of the applicants during her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
She made general allegation against all the family members of the applicant.

It is also submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that case of the present applicant is covered with the judgement passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court passed in Gita Mehrotra vs. State of U.P., 2012(10)ADJ 464.

entities.text: Gita Mehrotra vs. State of U.P., 2012(10)ADJ 464
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that there is no evidence of involvement of applicants in the crime.
No case under Sections498A, 354, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act is made out against the applicant.
It is submitted that order impugned is perverse and suffers from manifest error of law.
Learned Magistrate without applying his mind summoned the accused for facing the trial.

Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted thatduring her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., opposite party No. 2 has specifically stated that all family members were demanding additional dowry to her.
The cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record, the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

However, it is provided that in case the applicant applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, his application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicant surrenders and applies for bail, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 13.2.2024 SY  Mohd. Ayyaz @ Ashu Siddiqui vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135713350/
